title: Where to See the Berlin TV Tower - Quick Summary
items: **The best free views are outside Mitte.** From 1 to 12 km away the tower lines up with a street, the rail tracks, the river or a hill.
**Karl-Marx-Allee at U Frankfurter Tor:** the tower closes the old Stalinallee about 3 km west of you. Best in the morning light.
**Warschauer Brücke and Modersohnbrücke:** the tower over a wide fan of rail tracks. Come for sunset.
**Molecule Man:** stand at the Treptow end of Elsenbrücke to get the sculpture and the tower in one frame. Footways there are changing during bridge works.
**Mont Klamott in Volkspark Friedrichshain:** in early November the sun sets almost behind the tower. The view is a gap in the trees.
**Tempelhofer Feld** is free, open 07:00 to 18:00 in November, and the tower is lit from the front at any hour.
**Teufelsberg costs EUR 12** for adults, last entry 16:00 in November. Drachenberg next door is free with the same skyline.
